# Aventura Dental Center

> Family, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry in Aventura, FL, led by Dr. David S. Bistritz, DDS, serving the community since 1989. Rated 4.8 stars across 700+ Google reviews.

Aventura Dental Center is a full-service dental practice at 18171 Biscayne Blvd, Aventura, FL 33160.
- Phone: (305) 933-2501
- Email: info@aventuradentalcenter.com
- Hours: Monday-Thursday 8:00 AM-6:00 PM, Friday 8:00 AM-1:00 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Dentist: Dr. David S. Bistritz, DDS (founder, 37+ years of experience).
- Services: preventive care and cleanings, dental implants, All-on-4 implants, veneers, Invisalign clear aligners, crowns and bridges, teeth whitening, dental bonding, root canal treatment, dentures, tooth extractions, and emergency dentistry.
- Serving: Aventura, Golden Beach, Hallandale Beach, Downtown Hollywood, Ives Estates, Miami Gardens, North Miami Beach, Pembroke Park, and Sunny Isles Beach.

Book online at https://www.patientsreach.com/schedule/Aventura-Dental-Center/patient_types/ or call (305) 933-2501. New patients of all ages are welcome.
